# Original table-creation SQL

`original-create.json` was generated by `core/tests/java/TableDesignGolden.java`
calling the unmodified Java `DatabaseService.generateCreateTableSql` in the
read-only original checkout. It does not open a database or read configuration.

Nine cases cover MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle and Hive; actual database/schema
separation; comments and apostrophes; character sets; composite primary keys;
blank rows; defaults and the original temporal/precision/type-size rules.

SHA-256: `C33655B51DE7464EAB19465FC96809FC6F06671344A41C7A156B96616712D4D7`.

The original PostgreSQL/Oracle create generator omits column defaults,
auto-increment and column comments. The fixture records that limitation rather
than claiming those settings work. SQL generation for a dialect is separate
from having a native connection or a complete table-design window.

Native identifier quoting doubles embedded quote characters. MySQL execution
must also use its session's actual `NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES` setting when projecting
string literals; ordinary captured inputs produce the original SQL unchanged.


`original-types.json` comes from `TableTypeGolden.java`, invoking the unchanged original `DataTypeProvider` for 52 dialect/version cases. SHA-256: `50C1CE17D3AE5141B6E63FDF5B7BB6FD2B935CD0FAB0439C41DC434CB74E330E`. The original throws on the version `.`; Rust deliberately returns the older-version fallback instead of crashing. Null and empty versions retain their distinct original behavior.

`original-inference.json` comes from `FieldInferenceGolden.java`, invoking the unchanged original `FieldTypeInference` for 456 combinations of dialect, available JSON type and field name. SHA-256: `68358C817029BDAE5A30AF4B594950BF8DAB1B18DE47FE60066FF440E6817E2E`. The regression also checks that existing type, length and scale are not overwritten.

These are source behavior fixtures, not evidence that the complete table designer UI is connected or visually equivalent.
